blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Quiapo Church has unveiled the official logo for the Feast of the Black Nazareno in January 2027. The official logo features Jesus, Saint John the Baptist, the church, and the ropes used in the procession. Next year’s theme is “Tuwirin ninyo ang daraanan ng Panginoon,” which means “Make straight the way for the Lord,” based on John 1:23 in the Bible. “The symbol of Nazareno 2027 is an invitation for every devotee to continue walking the path of faith, devotion, and mission with and toward Jesus Nazarene,” Quiapo Church said in a Facebook post on Saturday.
